name: HEVC Compact Database
description: Compact 4K HEVC profiles for Radarr and Sonarr. Movies prefer the shared elite Blu-ray score (hallowed, BHDStudio, HONE and the rest of that list), then a smaller disc, then FLUX/Kitsune/CMRG, then PSA. A 4K micro and an untouched 4K WEB-DL such as BYNDR or NTb score 0 and do not clear the minimum, so the next grab is 1080p: elite, circle, streaming WEB, PSA, then a micro. Unrecognized 1080p HEVC and any 1080p AVC Blu-ray, WEB-DL, or WEBRip also score 3000 and do not stack on those tiers. A 720p HEVC or AVC Blu-ray, WEB-DL, or WEBRip scores 3000 in its own quality group below every 1080p quality. Inside a class, Dolby Vision is +1000, HDR is +500, HDR10+ is +600, Dolby Digital + is +125, and Dolby Digital is +115. 4K Blu-ray without HDR is rejected, and so is Dolby Vision with no HDR fallback. TrueHD and DTS-HD are rejected for direct play. Radarr max size stays unlimited. Preferred size is 130 MB/min at 2160p and 18 MB/min at 1080p, so a long movie is not rejected for its bitrate.
